# Repository Truth
Resolve exact current main/head, inspect canonical code/contracts/tests/workflows, active overlapping PRs, relevant migrations and production evidence. Treat chat, screenshots, handovers and historical CI only as leads. Record contradictions and refresh truth before certification/merge. Never design from an expected table, route, RPC or architecture that has not been found in current truth.
